name: manual_8a491a
claim: Before designing a new signed object, check whether an existing signed record already carries the property: a retained anchor event is a checkpoint with no new wire object or signing domain, at the cost of a consumer floor refusing permits below the anchor. Import a community standard's invariant, not its object, when the underlying structure differs.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-20: the spec asked for an issuer-signed chain checkpoint; every issuer event was already signed and hash-linked, so the event at the prune boundary is itself a signed version-and-digest. Community checkpoint formats solve a different problem (signed Merkle tree heads).
